copy:
Dig into some deviously delectable treats and beverages, while enjoying reserved seating in the preferred viewing area for Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party—presented only during Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party (a separate ticketed event) at Disney California Adventure Park.

You must have a valid event ticket for Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party to book this dessert party package. All members of your party must have a dessert party package to enter the preferred viewing area.

Tickets for Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party are sold out. If you already have tickets, you can book this separate Oogie Boogie Bash Dessert Party package for the same night.


The Oogie Boogie Bash Dessert Party package includes:

  • A signature Oogie Boogie-themed box of artisan charcuterie and cheeses with assorted accoutrements, Halloween-themed desserts and freeze-dried fruits
  • An exclusive collectible enamel pin
  • Reserved seating in the Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party preferred viewing area in front of Sonoma Terrace
  • An alcoholic beverage for Guests ages 21 and older
  • Unlimited soft drinks and bottled water, plus coffee, tea, hot chocolate and a nonalcoholic specialty beverage

Menu Highlights:

  • Artisan charcuterie and cheeses with assorted accoutrements
  • Triple chocolate cheesecake
  • Candy-coated chocolate crisped rice treat
  • Dubai chocolate-inspired filled bundt cake with pistachio crunch
  • Sugar cookie

Beverage Highlights

  • Oogie Boogie Bash nonalcoholic specialty beverage
  • Unlimited Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite and bottled water—plus coffee, tea and hot chocolate
  • For Guests ages 21 and older:
    • Beer
    • Wine
    • Oogie Boogie Bash specialty cocktail

2026 Dates
Reservations can be made on the same night of your event ticket for Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party at Disney California Adventure Park. The event takes place on the following dates:

  • August 18, 20, 23, 25, 27 and 30
  • September 1, 3, 6, 8, 10, 13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 24, 27 and 29
  • October 1, 4, 6, 8, 11, 13, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 27, 29 and 31

Tickets for Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party are sold out. If you already have tickets, you can book this separate Oogie Boogie Bash Dessert Party package for the same night.

Pricing

  • $94 per Guest

Price includes tax and gratuity. Please note that children ages 2 and under may attend free of charge, provided they are seated on the lap of an adult.
sections.title: Sweets and Reserved Seats

items.title: Theme Park Admission
items.content: Theme park admission is required and included with a valid event ticket for Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party, which is required to book this dining event.

items.title: Reservations
items.content:
You can make advance reservations on this page or via the Disneyland app. Same-day reservations can be made on a limited basis and are subject to availability. Full payment is due upon booking your reservation.

An event ticket for Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party is required to book this dining event and is not included in the price of the Oogie Boogie Bash Dessert Party.

Your reservation time is for the dessert party and not the performance time for Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party. The street party starts about 45 minutes after your dessert party reservation time. View the entertainment schedule or the Disneyland app for showtimes.

items.title: Alcoholic Beverages
items.content: To enjoy alcoholic beverages, Guests must be age 21 or older. A valid form of government identification will be required to verify your age. Original passports are the only form of identification acceptable for Guests from outside the United States; non-United States driver’s licenses, ID cards, temporary ID cards and copies of ID cards are not acceptable. Learn more about our alcohol policy by visiting our Frequently Asked Questions.

items.title: Arrival and Checking In
items.content:
Your reservation time is for the dessert party and not the performance time for Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party.

Check in using mobile check-in via the Disneyland app, which is available one hour prior to your reservation time.

You’ll receive a text when your table is ready and will be asked to return to the preferred viewing area in front of Sonoma Terrace. A Cast Member can help you find the viewing area.

Please arrive no sooner than 10 minutes prior to your reservation time. We may not be able to accommodate early or late arrivals.

Wristbands will be given when Guests are seated.

All members of your party must have a dessert party package to enter the viewing area. Accommodations for Guests with disabilities are available.

items.title: Special Dietary Requests
items.content:
When booking your reservation online or via the Disneyland app, look for the prompt to add any special dietary or allergy-friendly requests. Please note we cannot guarantee accommodations for day-of requests.

We use reasonable efforts in our food preparation and handling procedures to avoid the introduction of the most common allergens into your menu choices. While we take steps to prevent cross-contact, we do not have separate allergy-friendly kitchens and are unable to guarantee that a menu item is completely free of allergens. Additionally, allergy-friendly offerings are reliant on supplier ingredient labels, and we cannot guarantee the accuracy of the contents of each food item. Allergen advisory statements (e.g., “may contain”) are not regulated and therefore not taken into consideration when developing allergy-friendly meals. It is ultimately up to your discretion to make an informed choice based upon your individual dietary needs.

Once seated, let your server know if you have an allergy request—even if you previously indicated it during the reservation process. This will help ensure our special diets processes can be followed when preparing your meal.

items.title: Shared Seating
items.content: Due to limited space, Guests may be seated with other parties.

items.title: Children
items.content: All children must be accompanied by an adult 18 years of age or older for the duration of the dining and viewing experience.

items.title: Strollers and ECV Parking
items.content: Parking is located just outside the viewing area.

items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.content:
This package has a cancellation policy. The credit card provided at the time of reservation will automatically be charged a per-person fee if you don’t show up for your reservation or fail to cancel in accordance with the policy. Policy details will be available when you make your reservation and in your confirmation email.

Cancellations and modifications to reservations can be made by visiting My Dining and Activity Reservations or via the Disneyland app by tapping “Future Plans.”

items.title: Show Cancellation
items.content: Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party at Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party may be cancelled without notice due to technical, weather or other issues. There are no refunds unless the show is cancelled.

items.title: Experiences Subject to Change
items.content: Entertainment, experiences and offerings may be modified, limited in availability or unavailable, and are subject to restrictions and change—including pricing, hours, dates, times and performance times—or cancellation without notice. Park admission and offerings are not guaranteed.

items.title: Menu Subject to Change
items.content: All menu items and food options are subject to change without notice.
